)

0x1e

Synchronous
Reentrancy

Ethernet Transceiver Driver
Parameters (in)
An

association
Parameters (inout)
None

None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request
has not been accepted
Description
Request the Ethernet Transceiver Driver to remove the Transmission Secure Association
identified by the provided Association Number.
